designationHistory.name: Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Creedman Coulee National Wildlife Refuge by Executive Order 8924.

review.note: EO 8924, 1941-10-25 (Franklin D. Roosevelt). Draft name "Migratory Waterfowl Refuge" is a description, not a name; the EO title already says National Wildlife Refuge. Draft signer field held "Executive Order Number".

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Creedman Coulee National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1941 by Executive Order Number 8924 as a Migratory Waterfowl Refuge.
